description: Angular component for a switch widget in the Thingsboard UI, handling RPC and attribute subscriptions, rendering, and user interactions.

classes.name: SwitchComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a toggle switch with RPC and attribute subscription capabilities, including dynamic resizing and error handling.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes DOM references and sets up resize observer, then calls init().

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and disconnects resize observer.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, subscribes to data sources, and handles device RPC enablement.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Adjusts widget size and font based on container dimensions.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets font size for an element to fit within max width.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Measures text width with a given font size.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Displays error message and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Triggers RPC update with current value.

methods.name: rpcUpdateValue
methods.description: Updates value via RPC, handling concurrent updates.

methods.name: subscribeForValue
methods.description: Subscribes to attribute or timeseries data for value updates.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Handles incoming data updates and parses value.
